# GYM ARC - Art ids, ChatGPT batch (6 Nov)

Back to [[GYM ARC - Assets]]. Every image of the alter skins / alter VFX / aura VFX batch, uploaded 6 Nov to **Myanmar Builders Club** through Creator Hub (Development items > Upload assets). The game only reads them from `ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.ArtIds` (image ids). Work log: [[2026-11-06 GYM ARC Alter skins, alter VFX and auras on the new art]].

- `<name>_L_<map>` = arms / legs maps, `<name>_T_<map>` = torso + waist maps (2x denser tiling).
- Skins were uploaded 3 times (first pass, re-tiled pass 2, pass 3 for granite / vascular / clay / bronze / jade); the table lists the ids in use. Older uploads stay in the group unused.
- `v_alter_*` = alter VFX, `v_aura_*` = aura VFX (`_add` glow on black, `_alpha` coloured), `v_auraflat_*_ring` = the plain rings redrawn flat.
